Name: Cinque Verde
Timeform_comments: Below par for no obvious reason down the field in a handicap at Goodwood most recent run; in good form prior; suited by 5/6f, doesn't stay 7f, and a sound surface; could bounce back

Name: Thunder Blue
Timeform_comments: Well backed, returned to form beaten a short-head off 83 at Windsor last time; effective 6/7f, acts on any; extreme hold-up horse on competitive mark

Name: Expert Agent
Timeform_comments: Back to best scored by 1 1/4l off 74 at Haydock three starts back; disappointing for no obvious reason beaten 6l off 80 last time; suited by 6f and sound surface; hit and miss

Name: Rajaking
Timeform_comments: Suited by drop back in trip beaten 1/2l off 80 here last time; effective 6f, acts on GF and AW; has probably found form

Name: Dapper Guest
Timeform_comments: Scored by 1/2l off 68 over 7f here three starts back; fraction below par on easy ground beaten 4 1/2l off 75 last time; suited by 7f, acts on good, likes fast ground; in solid form

Name: Equiano Springs
Timeform_comments: Best run this term off falling mark beaten 1/2l off 69 here last time; suited by 6f, better on sound surface; Newmarket specialist, on workable mark

Name: Toyotomi
Timeform_comments: Got behind on tight track beaten 4 1/4l in Queensferry Stakes (Listed) at Chester last time; effective 5/6f, may prefer some give; bit to prove in Britain

Name: Apollo One
Timeform_comments: Would have been 2l closer with a clear run beaten 5 1/2l in a handicap at Goodwood last time; suited by 6f, acts on any; has run into form

Name: Elmonjed
Timeform_comments: Got no run but off a stiff mark and found little when gaps came beaten 10l in a handicap at Goodwood last time; trainer in form; suited by 6f, acts on good to soft and good to firm; consistent

Name: Ferrous
Timeform_comments: Below form in Group company down the field in Hackwood Stakes (Group 3) at Newbury most recent start; usually consistent; suited by 6f, acts on any; probably better off in handicaps

Name: Iberian
Timeform_comments: Didn't seem to stay well beaten in Lennox Stakes (Group 2) over 7f at Goodwood latest; ideally wants 6f and some give; can bounce back down in trip

Name: Lethal Levi
Timeform_comments: Every chance and ran to form fourth beaten 2l in Criterion Stakes (Group 3) over 7f at York latest; enjoys making it; off a short-break; suited by 6/7f, best on sound surface, likes fast ground; reliable

Name: Shagraan
Timeform_comments: Moderate effort on softening ground beaten 5l in a handicap over 5f at Goodwood last time; suited by 5/6f and a sound surface; should return to form

Name: Pellitory
Timeform_comments: Ran to form off stiff enough mark in competitive handicap beaten 4l in a handicap over 7f at Goodwood last time; visor first time; suited by 7/8f and good or soft ground; largely consistent

Name: Dubai Treasure
Timeform_comments: Well backed continued progress when winning a handicap at Goodwood by a neck last time; effective 6/7f on a sound surface; open to further improvement

Name: Inis Mor
Timeform_comments: Green in front but came clear with second when 1 1/4l winner in a novice here on debut; middle-distance bred, hits ground quite hard; big, workmanlike sort, should improve

Name: Blue Samuna
Timeform_comments: 29 Mar; 18,000gns Space Blues filly; half-sister to Brave Byreflection, useful at 7f; dam smart at 8f at 2yo; one of two for yard and market may prove best guide to chances

Name: City Queen
Timeform_comments: Yard won this last year; 25 Apr; Dubawi filly; dam high-class at 10f; one of two for top yard; market may guide

Name: Enchanted Queen
Timeform_comments: Yard won this last year; 27 Feb; Ghaiyyath filly; dam high-class at middle-distancew/stayer; on of two for top trainer

Name: Harlequin Breeze
Timeform_comments: 16 Mar; 70,000gns breeze-up purchase by New Bay; dam smart from 12f to 13f; market will be best guide to chances

Name: On Message
Timeform_comments: Yard has won 2 of last 5 runnings of race; 29 Jan; Camelot filly; half-sister to Declared Interest, smart at 8f; dam smart at 8f; from a good yard

Name: Remi Mae
Timeform_comments: 6 Mar; 75,000gns Invincible Spirit filly; half-sister to Tribal Nation, smart at 7f; dam high-class at 7f; top trainer and could be one of sharper debutants

Name: Tashi Delek
Timeform_comments: 18 Jan; 250,000gns Night Of Thunder filly; dam useful at 7f at 2yo; trainer in form; most expensive purchase in the field

Name: Ventana
Timeform_comments: 21 Feb; 60,000 euros Supremacy filly; half-sister to Secret Angel, very smart at 6f; dam high-class at 7f; probably need the run

Name: Wild Dahlia
Timeform_comments: 13 Apr; £65,000 breeze-up purchase by Ardad; half-sister to Arts Of War, useful from 7f (at 2yo) to 9f; dam smart at 10f; represents top yard

Name: Angel Shared
Timeform_comments: All out in finish involving four others landing a handicap by 1/2l off 81 here last time; enjoys making it; suited by 5/6f, acts on any; may have reached ceiling but very game

Name: Raneenn
Timeform_comments: Probably wanted further beaten 4l off 86 over 5f at Ascot last time; hood first time; trainer in form; effective 6/7f, acts on good to soft and good to firm; form has tailed off

Name: Miss Show Off
Timeform_comments: Raced too freely beaten 6l in a handicap over 5f at Ascot last time; effective 5/6f on a sound surface; in and out of form

Name: Arabian Leopard
Timeform_comments: Ran to form beaten 3l off 81 at Goodwood last time; suited by 6/7f and a sound surface; in form

Name: Greydreambeliever
Timeform_comments: Made plenty of use of but cheekpieces looked less effective second time down the field in a handicap at Goodwood most recent start; suited by 6f and a sound surface; temperament to prove

Name: Swiss Lightning
Timeform_comments: Ran to best maiden form on handicap debut down in trip beaten 3/4l off 78 at Leicester last time; cheekpieces first time; significant jockey booking; suited by 6f, acts on a sound surface; workable mark

Name: Cuban Lady
Timeform_comments: Didn't quite get home after racing too freely beaten 2l off 77 here last time; suited by 6f, acts on a sound surface; open to improvement if will settle better

Name: Classic Speed
Timeform_comments: Ran poorly, perhaps not handling fast ground comfortably held in a handicap over 9f at Epsom last time; suited by 1m on AW; yet to show much on turf and has lost form

Name: Calibos
Timeform_comments: Scored by 4l off 61 at Windsor penultimate start; race probably came too soon when well beaten off 67 last time; suited by 10f, acts on any; likely to return to form

Name: Arundel
Timeform_comments: Scored by 2l off 58 at Pontefract in May; visored and suited by step-up in trip when second beaten 1/2l off 65 last time; effective 10f, 12f suits, acts on good to soft and good to firm; staying type, open to improvement

Name: Huggable
Timeform_comments: Well handicapped on novice form, step-up in trip suited landing a handicap by 6l off 60 at Epsom last time; suited by 10f and a sound surface; quirky but remains well treated at weights

Name: Betty Bassett
Timeform_comments: Yard won this last year; scored by a head off 62 at Wetherby in June; ridden to stay and debatable whether really saw it out fifth beaten 3 1/4l off 64 last time; suited by 10f and a sound surface; fraction below best of late

Name: Gretna Dreams
Timeform_comments: Back to best ridden near pace on a sharp track landing a handicap by 2 1/2l off 56 at Brighton last time; suited by easy 10f and sound surface; needs the right conditions

Name: Venezuelan
Timeform_comments: Well backed, making running suited though race fell apart when winning a maiden at Lingfield by 13l last time; suited by 12f and a sound surface; looks irresolute and untrustworthy

Name: Atlantic Sunset
Timeform_comments: Scored by a length off 74 here penultimate start; raced lazily beaten 12l off 78 last time; suited by 12f and a sound surface; yard's out of form runners usually bounce back

Name: Bondi
Timeform_comments: Scored by 3/4l off 68 over 11f at Windsor penultimate start; disappointing up 5lb beaten 13l off 73 last time; suited by 12f and fast ground; had been progressive

Name: Mount Atlas
Timeform_comments: Smart sort who was back to winning ways at Ascot last time; acts on any but particularly effective on fast; 5lb rise for last time means more is needed to follow up here.

Name: Naqeeb
Timeform_comments: On a losing run of 12 but some good efforts in top 10-12f handicaps lately, including latest second over 10f at Goodwood last time; leading player.

Name: This Songisforyou
Timeform_comments: Ran okay on the figures when fifth of six in a 12f Gr 3 last time; interesting on last September's 10f win at the Curragh and is shrewd trainer's only runner here over the four days.

Name: Insanity
Timeform_comments: Down the field in this last year but may well fare better this time, with such as his win at Ayr three starts back and latest sound third at Ascot entitling him to be thereabouts.

Name: French Duke
Timeform_comments: Yard won this last year; slowly away when bit disappointing over 1m6f at Goodwood most recent run; return to 12f may help but needs to rediscover his good 2024 form.

Name: Champagne Prince
Timeform_comments: Well below-par at Newmarket most recently, since when he has been gelded; better on the AW and looks on a high enough mark on balance of his turf form; others preferred.

Name: Chillingham
Timeform_comments: Interesting off this mark on the pick of his form and though below-par here latest, that was a muddling event; awarded the race in the stewards' room here in June; worth considering.

Name: Zanndabad
Timeform_comments: Hinted that all of his Flat ability remains when set a lot to do in the Northumberland Plate (2m, AW) last time in June; ran well hurdling latest; longer trip would suit better; each-way chance.

Name: Asgards Captain
Timeform_comments: Bit up and down lately but did run to form at Ascot last time and, with trip/ground fine, has each-way chance.

Name: Marhaba The Champ
Timeform_comments: Won this in 2023 and though not so good nowadays, latest second at Doncaster (10f) was best run for a long while; sold out of Kevin Ryan's yard for 8,000gns since; considered.

Name: Austrian Theory
Timeform_comments: Interesting on his sound fifth in top 10.3f handicap here last month but less good twice since and bit to prove overall; stamina beyond 10.3f is unproven.

Name: Trawlerman
Timeform_comments: Top-class stayer who ran them ragged in the Gold Cup (2m4f) at Ascot last time; fully effective at 2m while he won only previous start here (2022 Ebor); should be very hard to pass.

Name: Al Nayyir
Timeform_comments: Only just edged out in this last year but not quite so good this season, including well-held third to Trawlerman at Sandown in May; others preferred.

Name: Al Qareem
Timeform_comments: Admirably reliable front-running 6yo who comes here in fine form after two recent 14f wins here; stays 15f on soft and 2m shouldn't be an issue; more needed against the top two here.

Name: Dubai Future
Timeform_comments: Similar level to Gold Cup form when running very respectably in Goodwood Cup last time; stays 2m, acts on a sound surface; work to do to trouble the top two here.

Name: Sweet William
Timeform_comments: Very consistent and high-class 6yo who found 2m4f too far in Ascot Gold Cup but was back to form when third in Goodwood Cup last time; the clear main danger to Trawlerman.

Name: Shackleton
Timeform_comments: Smart 3yo though form doesn't compare to the two top-rated here; step up to 2m may well suit; ran to best when second in 14f Gr 2 latest; cheekpieces first time; vulnerable, all told.

Name: Comical Point
Timeform_comments: Yard won this last year; raced far too freely in Gr 2 at Newmarket last time; in good form prior and still isn't fully exposed, so well worth considering for top trainer-jockey combo.

Name: Do Or Do Not
Timeform_comments: Still a maiden but sets the standard on placed runs in three Gr 2s, last time upped to 7f at Goodwood; cheekpieces first time; not sure this flat 6f will be ideal but strong form claims.

Name: Egoli
Timeform_comments: Raced on 'wrong' part of course in Gr 2 at Goodwood last time and readily excused that; in good form prior to that; suited by 6f, acts on good and fast; needs more but isn't fully exposed.

Name: Irish Fighter
Timeform_comments: Creditable fifth in the Super Sprint at Newbury last time; has raced only at 5f; something to find up in grade.

Name: Lifeplan
Timeform_comments: A length winner in a 6f novice at Thirsk on debut, when backed beforehand; this is quite a bit harder but that debut win was very promising.

Name: Reciprocated
Timeform_comments: 450,000gns yearling; too free and highly likely didn't stay in Listed race over 7f at Ascot last time; highly promising in two 6f wins before that; very much a contender back at 6f again now.

Name: Rock On Thunder
Timeform_comments: 380,000gns yearling; ran to form when 4l second to a smart winner in 6f Listed race at Newbury latest; bit more probably needed.

Name: Yorkshire Puds
Timeform_comments: Twice-raced maiden; down the field in a maiden at Goodwood most recently; difficult to fancy at this level.

Name: Jm Jungle
Timeform_comments: In form but improved markedly to win Gr 2 at Goodwood last time; suited by 5f, acts on any; thoroughly admirable sort who has place claims if he can confirm that latest improvement.

Name: Kerdos
Timeform_comments: Smart sort who probably raced on the 'wrong' side at Goodwood last time; acts on any ground; up and down in recent times and bit to prove overall; cheekpieces worn latest are left off.

Name: Manaccan
Timeform_comments: Gradually refinding his form since back from two years off, last time fourth in Ascot handicap; even the best of his old form would need improving upon; others preferred.

Name: Night Raider
Timeform_comments: Best form so far on AW but has never had the chance to run on a fast, flat 5f on quick turf, conditions he'll finally have here; has speed to burn and very bold show wouldn't surprise.

Name: Rumstar
Timeform_comments: Bit below best at The Curragh last time; suited by 5f, acts on any, likes it fast; best form, such as when showing late burst in two 2025 Gr 3 wins, makes him a contender.

Name: Spartan Arrow
Timeform_comments: Yard won this last year; well held up in class in Gr 2 at Goodwood last time; suited by an easy 5f and a sound surface; smart sort but this demands a career-best.

Name: Washington Heights
Timeform_comments: Very respectable sixth in this last year; form of latest C&D Listed-race win is working out well and each-way claims on that.

Name: Aint Nobody
Timeform_comments: Plenty to find on balance of form, last time down the field in Listed race over 6f at Chester last time; cheekpieces first time; return to 5f may help but too much to find to appeal much.

Name: Arizona Blaze
Timeform_comments: Dependable colt who comes here in great form at 5-6f, last time winning well in 5f Gr 2 at The Curragh; that followed an excellent in 6f Gr 1 at Ascot; leading contender.

Name: Asfoora
Timeform_comments: Ran to current form and still below best at Goodwood last time but ground there slower than ideal; sound fourth in this last year but even better form earlier in 2024; needs to refind that.

Name: Frost At Dawn
Timeform_comments: Ground was a bit slower than ideal when running well in Gr 2 at Goodwood latest; previous second of 20 in Ascot Gr 1 makes her an each-way player and trip/ground here are ideal.

Name: Mgheera
Timeform_comments: Ran okay in second at The Curragh latest when tardy start didn't help; fast ground an unknown but form of her Gr 2 win at Haydock in May is good and is well worth considering.

Name: Shes Quality
Timeform_comments: Four very good runs in second place this season, last time in Gr 2 at Goodwood; the emphasis on out-and-out speed in this particular race is a plus and well worth considering.

Name: Celandine
Timeform_comments: Won Gr 2 Lowther (6f) here last year; bit below-par latest but previous reappearance third here (6f) showed she'd trained on; seemed to find 5f too sharp once last season.

Name: Sayidah Dariyan
Timeform_comments: Travelled very well and then quickened when winning Gr 3 here over 6f last time; steadily progressive and may well be able to bridge the gap to Gr 1 level; probably pacey enough for 5f.

Name: Lady Iman
Timeform_comments: Only defeat in five runs came when outstayed over 6f; decisive win in 5f Gr 3 at Goodwood last time; suited by 5f and a sound surface; 2yos can win this race and much respected.

Name: Spicy Marg
Timeform_comments: Back on track with decisive win in useful race at Goodwood last time; trip/ground look ideal but the other 2yo here, Lady Iman, has superior form so this filly needs to improve.

Name: Akecheta
Timeform_comments: Unraced on faster than good; mostly creditable runs recently, last time finishing well from off the pace for fourth at Goodwood; this is arguably less competitive and leading claims.

Name: Ciara Pearl
Timeform_comments: Bit below-par over 12f at Ascot last time; stays that trip but 10f is probably her optimum; bit more needed on balance of recent form.

Name: Power Of Destiny
Timeform_comments: Trip/ground are fine and definite claims on best form but she will need to step up on recent below-par efforts, last time at Goodwood.

Name: Roarin Success
Timeform_comments: Game when winning at Hamilton on penultimate start and ran well again when front-running second at Doncaster last time; bit more needed in this better-contested race.

Name: Zgharta
Timeform_comments: Didn't get a clear run when catching the eye at Goodwood (1m) last time; 10f winner earlier this season; much respected for leading trainer-jockey combination.

Name: Fiver Friday
Timeform_comments: Well beaten in a handicap hurdle at Sligo latest; in better form on the Flat before that but more needed even on those efforts; fast ground would be a concern.

Name: Wonder Star
Timeform_comments: Lightly-raced filly who was good second in competitive race at Goodwood last time on handicap debut; big chance on that up 2lb and ought to still be open to improvement.

Name: Bint Al Daar
Timeform_comments: Hasn't been firing at all in recent runs and risky proposition at present; however, she's 8lb lower than when second in this last year and not ruled out in cheekpieces for the first time.

Name: Jujubella
Timeform_comments: Scored at Haydock on penultimate start; that was at a shade further but this trip is fine too; bit to find on balance up in grade.

Name: Brielle
Timeform_comments: Fulfilled previous 8-12f promise when improving to win 1m novice at Hamilton latest; by stamina influence sire, so that augurs well for 10.3f; more needed but she's a potential improver.

Name: Cape Flora
Timeform_comments: Much-improved when winning at Leicester (10f) last time; up 11lb in better grade race but she's very well-bred and hails from a top yard, so could easily be up to it.

Name: Callisto Dream
Timeform_comments: Lightly raced so it's possible she can find the bit more needed; however, pedigree raises stamina question upped in trip and others are preferred.

Name: Blessed Star
Timeform_comments: Consistent maiden at up to 1m, last time creditable third in Goodwood handicap; elements of pedigree are encouraging as regards 10.3f; worth considering.

Name: Beny Nahar
Timeform_comments: Similar level of form in two second places, last time in a novice at Haydock (7f; led, bit keen there); one of the likelier form contenders and has to be respected.

Name: Bond
Timeform_comments: Well held fifth in a maiden over 8f at Killarney on debut; only 4-1 there so better was evidently expected; others appeal more.

Name: Ephron
Timeform_comments: 24 March foal; 52,000euros breeze-up purchase by Calyx; dam useful at 10f; likely best watched.

Name: Explosive Finnish
Timeform_comments: Just a modicum of promise in a novice over 5f at Nottingham on debut; highly likely best watched.

Name: Frescobaldi
Timeform_comments: Benefited from debut experience when close second in a maiden at Fairyhouse (7f) latest, going clear but nabbed late on; top yard won this in 2023; leading player.

Name: Ice Cube
Timeform_comments: 19 February foal; 50,000gns Phoenix Of Spain colt; dam very useful at 8f; likely best watched.

Name: Inishbeg
Timeform_comments: 8 February foal; 500,000gns Ghaiyyath colt; half-brother to Volterra, very smart at 7f; dam useful at 6f; interesting on paper and warrants a market check for sure.

Name: King Of Thunder
Timeform_comments: Some promise when 5l fourth in a maiden over 6f at Ascot on debut but this definitely demands more.

Name: Naval Light
Timeform_comments: 360,000gns 2yo; plenty of ability in three runs at 5-6f, last time second at Goodwood latest; shapes as though he'll stay 7f; sets the standard on form and leading contender.

Name: New Monarch
Timeform_comments: Second in both starts, at Newbury and then Ascot (led), both at 6f; pedigree suggests 7f should suit; bit more needed for his leading trainer-jockey combination.

Name: Night Wolf
Timeform_comments: 17 February foal; 160,000gns Kodi Bear colt; half-brother to Galen, high-class at 10f; dam smart from 5f to 6f; probably best watched on debut.

Name: Red Spells Danger
Timeform_comments: Promising debut third in a C&D novice last month; that form is reasonable and though more is needed here, not ruled out.

Name: Sea The Power
Timeform_comments: Raced freely when quite promising debut third third in a novice at Beverley debut; plenty more needed here, though.

Name: Spyce
Timeform_comments: 8 March foal; 280,000gns breeze-up purchase by Too Darn Hot; half-brother to Accentuate, very useful at 8f; dam very useful at 8f; worth a precautionary market check.

Name: Isle of Fernandez
Timeform_comments: Had benefited from debut experience when second in a 7f fillies' maiden at Goodwood latest; more needed against colts this time.

Name: Fearnot
Timeform_comments: Most progressive and came on again when winning good handicap at Ascot last time; unraced as a 2yo and may continue progressing; 5lb rise is fair; leading player.

Name: Dividend
Timeform_comments: Progressive colt who ran very well when fourth of 30 in top handicap at Ascot last time back in June; off a short break now; bit more needed up 4lb but could come on again.

Name: Supido
Timeform_comments: Creditable runs in two very good 1m Ascot handicaps lately (better run in the first of them); cheekpieces first time; looks more exposed than some and may be vulnerable win-wise.

Name: Montpellier
Timeform_comments: Lightly-raced and gradually progressive 3yo who ran well when running-on fourth at Goodwood (7f) last time; very much a contender upped to 1m now.

Name: Yah Mo Be There
Timeform_comments: Shaped as though a return to 1m might well suit when running-on fifth over 7f in decent handicap at Goodwood last time; met some trouble there too; feasible mark; interesting runner.

Name: Tiger Mask
Timeform_comments: Useful 2yo but didn't show enough on belated seasonal debut on Newcastle AW in June to make much appeal for now; cheekpieces first time; upped to 1m now.

Name: Fifth Column
Timeform_comments: Game when scoring at Newmarket (1m) on penultimate start before running well enough at Goodwood (when soft was possibly not ideal); top trainer-jockey combo; shortlisted.

Name: Teroomm
Timeform_comments: Too free last time and needs to settle better; Oisin Murphy taking over may well help and this colt has definite claims on the form of his good win at Haydock three starts back in May.

Name: Big Leader
Timeform_comments: Made it three from three with narrow success on handicap debut at Thirsk last time; up 3lb in a better-contested race but he ought to be open to further progress.

Name: Sea Force
Timeform_comments: Yard won this last year; creditable series of runs continued at Goodwood last time; first-time cheekpieces worn there are left off; worth considering.

Name: King Casper
Timeform_comments: Down the field in a handicap at Goodwood most recent, though ground there was possibly unsuitable; others are more progressive and appeal more.

Name: We Dare To Dream
Timeform_comments: Mostly creditable runs this season before below-par run at Goodwood latest (ground not as testing as 'heavy' description suggests and should have done better); opposable now.

Name: Impartiality
Timeform_comments: Remains gradually progressive, last time showing career-best form when second at Goodwood; ground any faster than good an unknown but much respected otherwise.

Name: Sir Paul Ramsey
Timeform_comments: Career-best form with narrow success at Haydock last time; may be open to further progress at 1m so not ruled out despite being 5lb higher in better grade than last time.

Name: Point Of Contact
Timeform_comments: Didn't get a clear run when running creditably at Goodwood last time; this lightly-raced colt hails from a leading yard and is very much an each-way contender.

Name: Miami Matrix
Timeform_comments: Progressive vein of form came to an end with down-the-field effort at Goodwood last time; cheekpieces first time; bit to find overall and others are preferred.

Name: Knights Gold
Timeform_comments: Having a fine season and though thwarted in his bid for a fifth win of 2025 last time, that close third (hampered) at Goodwood means he's very much an each-way contender at least here.

Name: Dynamic Force
Timeform_comments: Forced wide from a poor draw and beaten 3 1/4l in a 7f handicap at Naas last time. Generally out of form; effective on fast ground up to 1m on the flat, but stamina remains to be proven over hurdles.

Name: Matt Connor
Timeform_comments: Made too much use of and finished down the field in a 12f handicap at The Curragh last time. Hood first time and back from a short break. A 10f flat winner but out of form and with a bit to prove starting over hurdles.

Name: Kabylia
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when second, beaten 1/2l in a 2m1f maiden hurdle at Cork last time. A bumper winner, she has been consistent over hurdles, is suited by good ground, and looks capable of winning soon.

Name: Butch Coolidge
Timeform_comments: Ran well for a long way on bumper debut but was well beaten in a 2m2f bumper at Cork last time. Needs to show more now back over hurdles.

Name: Itsaworkinmaniam
Timeform_comments: Improved to win a maiden at Ballingarry over 3m by a length last time and returns from a short break. A 3m point winner who may be better suited to staying trips over hurdles.

Name: Beir Bua
Timeform_comments: Still a touch green but ran to form when winning a mares' bumper at Wexford by 2 1/4l last time. Consistent in bumpers on good and yielding to soft ground.

Name: King Bob
Timeform_comments: Made a poor hurdles debut when down the field in a 2m2f maiden hurdle at Cork most recently. Looks one for the future rather than immediate success.

Name: Eye Of A Tiger
Timeform_comments: Below form despite strong support when 9l third in a 2m2f maiden hurdle at Sligo last time. Proven effective between 2m and 2m1f on good ground.

Name: Randall Poets Lass
Timeform_comments: Ran poorly when beaten 7 1/4l in a Tramore handicap last time. A longstanding and frustrating maiden under both codes.

Name: Ailbhe Ava
Timeform_comments: Green and made mistakes on debut when well beaten in a 2m1f maiden hurdle at Wexford. Backed in the betting that day, so should be capable of better.

Name: Awakening
Timeform_comments: Novicey jumping on debut when comfortably held in a 2m2f maiden hurdle at Sligo last time. Generally out of form, but capable of better judged on flat form.

Name: Miss Bella Vista
Timeform_comments: Green and made mistakes on debut when well beaten in a maiden hurdle at Roscommon. Should improve with the experience.

Name: Top Spin Lob
Timeform_comments: Outpaced and failed to handle the surface when down the field in an 11f novice at Southwell last time. Returns from a long layoff, but showed minor ability over middle distances in the UK last summer.

Name: Avondale
Timeform_comments: Outpaced but finished strongly when fourth, beaten 3l, in the COLM QUINN BMW Novice Hurdle (Listed) over 2m1f at Galway last time. Steadily progressive and may prefer slightly further than 2m.

Name: Catena Zapata
Timeform_comments: Quickened and improved for better ground under a positive ride when winning the Conditions Hurdle at Downpatrick over 2m2f by 5 1/2l last time. Could figure here.

Name: Costacurta
Timeform_comments: Improved from debut, with winning margin exaggerated by a faller when landing a maiden hurdle here by 17l last time. Off a short break and effective between 16f and 19f; still progressing.

Name: Dysart Dasher
Timeform_comments: From the yard that won this last year. Quickened clear early and won a maiden hurdle here by 3l last time. Steadily progressive and can improve again if settling.

Name: Full Confession
Timeform_comments: From the yard successful in this last year. Improved as a cosy winner when suited by a positive ride down in trip, winning a maiden hurdle at Downpatrick over 2m2f by 2l last time. Progressing and will get further in time.

Name: Ebony King
Timeform_comments: Made a very promising debut, showing a willing attitude when winning a maiden hurdle at Galway over 2m1f by 2 1/2l last time. Form franked and more to come; may stay a bit further than 2m.

Name: Liceo
Timeform_comments: Improved but not knocked about after a late error when well beaten in a maiden hurdle over 2m1f at Wexford last time; generally out of form, though progressing and capable of better judged on French flat form.

Name: Malbas

Timeform_comments: Improved when scoring by 3/4l off 92 over 2m2f at Sligo two starts back, quickening and holding on gamely; still green with mistakes when making too much use of last time, finishing 14th beaten 23l off 102; this demands more.

Name: Brave Soldier
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when 6 1/4l third in a handicap hurdle over 2m5f at Sligo on latest start; consistent.

Name: Reiki Revolution

Name: Krishna Bellevue

Name: Messi Magic

Name: Mighty Berkshire
Timeform_comments: Ran to debut form when comfortably held in a 2m6f maiden hurdle at Galway last time. Effective from 2 1/2m to 3/4m, shapes like a stayer and worth a try at 3m.

Name: Quantum Quest
Timeform_comments: From a yard that won this last year. Rallied gamely and ran to form when second, beaten 10l, in a 2m6f maiden hurdle at Downpatrick latest. Steadily progressive and generally consistent, with point form and recent effort suggesting 3m may suit.

Name: Cuguilla
Timeform_comments: Green and never threatened when well beaten on debut in a 2m maiden hurdle here on her only start. Best watched for now.

Name: Long Road

Name: Dawn Escape
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when stepping up in trip and grade, finishing fourth and beaten 8l in a handicap chase over 3m1f here last time.

Name: Movie King
Timeform_comments: Ran to form and looked in need of the run when fitness gave way late, finishing 5 1/4l third in a handicap chase over 2m4f here most recently. Well treated on old form and should improve for that outing.

Name: My Friend The Wind
Timeform_comments: Returned to form but was comfortably held in a handicap chase over 2m6f at Roscommon last time. Generally out of form but probably needs this 3m now.

Name: Ballagh Star
Timeform_comments: Appeared unsuited by the drop in trip when finishing down the field in a handicap chase over 2m6f at Tramore most recently. Not out of it.

Name: Thehairyfella

Name: Hit The Frame
Timeform_comments: Improved up in trip with an aggressive ride in first-time blinkers, going clear but beaten 3l off 79 in a handicap chase over 3m1f at Roscommon last time. Threat if building on that.

Name: Container Madness
Timeform_comments: Never threatened but was ridden to see out the trip when well beaten in a handicap hurdle over 3m1f at Roscommon latest. Usually held up and should come on for that run. Of interest on chase debut.

Name: Early Arrival
Timeform_comments: Pulled up in a handicap chase over 2m6f at Tramore last time. Yet to take to chasing. May now prefer easier ground.

Name: Tuff Days
Timeform_comments: Fell in a handicap hurdle over 3m at Wexford last time and is out of form. Remains a maiden.

Name: Captain Kate
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when outpaced but saw out the trip well on chase debut, comfortably held in a handicap chase over 3m1f at Roscommon last time. Generally out of form and inconsistent in a short career.

Name: Tennesse Boy
Timeform_comments: Pulled up in a handicap hurdle over 2m4f at Tramore last time and has yet to show anything.

Name: Father Jed
Timeform_comments: Continued in poor form when down the field in a handicap hurdle over 3m at Fairyhouse most recently. Generally out of form, returning from a long layoff, and looks regressive.

Name: Ho My Lord
Timeform_comments: Made mistakes but still ran to form when comfortably held in a 2m4f handicap chase at Wexford last time. Generally out of form and has a bit to find.

Name: Invictus Machin
Timeform_comments: Winner of this race last year; ran to form when beaten 8 1/2l in a 2m7f handicap chase at Galway last time. Usually held up, with a top jockey back on board, but has a bit to find.

Name: Nouvotic
Timeform_comments: From a yard that has won two of the last ten renewals. Showed determination and improved from debut when winning a beginners' chase over 2m3f at Wexford by 2 1/2l last time. Should prove competitive in handicaps.

Name: Sea Aster
Timeform_comments: Latest form franked. Improved in a weaker race and won by 2l off 117 over 3m at Perth three runs back. Unsuited by how the race unfolded when a poor fourth, beaten 34l off 120 last time. Holds only a minor chance.

Name: Dorans Law
Timeform_comments: Benefited from a late faller when scoring by 5l off 109 at Wexford two starts ago. Travelled well but flattened out after a bad mistake when fourth, beaten 17l off 111 last time. On a good mark based on chase form and may prefer some ease in the ground.

Name: Hascoeur Clermont
Timeform_comments: Badly hampered by a loose horse and never competitive when comfortably held in a handicap chase at Wexford last time. Generally out of form but worth another chance.

Name: Bal Kauto
Timeform_comments: Won easily at Galway last time. Now up 13lb but still well treated on chase form. Improved again when landing a 2m6f handicap by 5l off 104 and may have more to offer over staying trips over hurdles.

Name: Fairyhill Run
Timeform_comments: Fell in a handicap chase at Wexford last time. Enjoys making the running but has a bit to find.

Name: Barrakilla Vage
Timeform_comments: Far too keen and below debut form when finishing down the field in a bumper at Tramore last time; usually consistent; has worn a hood but still needs to learn to settle.

Name: Carrig Padraig
Timeform_comments: Ran to form but was comfortably held in a bumper at Wexford last time; plenty more required to get off the mark.

Name: Groucho Max
Timeform_comments: Poor debut when well beaten in a bumper over 2m1f at Clonmel last time; off a short break; yet to show much in points or under rules.

Name: Onlyforfrankie
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when fourth, beaten 6l, in a maiden over 3m at Ballingarry last time; off a short break; showed minor promise in points.

Name: Red Oak
Timeform_comments: Yard won this race last year; promising debut in a good contest when beaten 9 1/4l in a bumper over 2m2f at Galway last time; should improve for the initial experience.

Name: Sonny Koufax
Timeform_comments: Fell in a maiden over 3m at Lingstown last time; has shown little in points.

Name: Cailin Deas
Timeform_comments: Ran to form, doing much the best of those coming from off the pace when fourth beaten 5 1/4l in a mares bumper over 2m1f at Galway last time; consistent at 2m on decent ground in bumpers.

Name: Dunbell Diva
Timeform_comments: Affinisea mare; half-sister to Pats Gift, who was poor at 19f; probably need this initial experience.

Name: Keep It Together
Timeform_comments: Has no worthwhile form; has beaten only one home in four starts under rules.

Name: Sellerna Bay
Timeform_comments: Still green under pressure but ran to form when second, beaten 1/2l, in a mares bumper over 2m1f at Wexford last time; suited by 2m on good ground and can win a bumper.

Name: Extravagant
Timeform_comments: Outpaced and unsuited by the drop in trip when well beaten in a 6f nursery at The Curragh on handicap debut. Generally out of form and needs at least 7f, with the potential to do better over 1m.

Name: Bellamano
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when second, beaten a neck, in a 7f auction race at Galway last time. Steadily progressive and consistent over 7-8f on easy ground. Trainer in form and looks a solid contender.

Name: Invincible Will
Timeform_comments: Conceded first run but ran to form on handicap debut when beaten 1/2l off 73 over 7f at Galway, benefitting from the drop in grade. Effective at 7f and may get 1m; looks on a good mark.

Name: Clarity of Thought
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when well beaten in a 7f maiden at Down Royal last time. Usually consistent, with a trainer who excels at this course. Effective over 6-7f on good or soft ground and may progress in handicaps.

Name: Farabove The Limit
Timeform_comments: Possibly ran too soon when well beaten in a 7f auction race at Galway last time. Inconsistent in maidens and needs to improve to make an impact in handicaps.

Name: The Holy Apostle
Timeform_comments: Outpaced and outclassed when down the field in a 7f maiden at The Curragh most recently. Blinkers applied for the first time following a short break. Yet to build on a promising debut and bred for middle distances.

Name: Down The Glen
Timeform_comments: A little below form in a good 6f maiden at Naas last time. Generally consistent, with a significant jockey booking. Likely to be better suited to further than 6f in nurseries.

Name: Quinns Charm

Name: Sara La Belle
Timeform_comments: Returned to form when fourth, beaten 6 1/2l, in a 7f nursery at Galway last time. Wears a hood for the first time. Effective at 6-7f on good or soft ground but needs a bit more to break her maiden.

Name: Femme Beauty
Timeform_comments: Back to form in first-time headgear when fourth, beaten 8 1/4l, in a 7f maiden at Down Royal last time. Inconsistent over 6-7f so far, though may stay 1m.

Name: Collecting Coin
Timeform_comments: Ran to form with an easy win in a maiden at Galway over 7f by 3l last time; consistent over 7-8f on good and soft.

Name: Sujet
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when fourth, beaten 3l in a 9f handicap at Galway latest; ridden by a top course jockey; acts on good to firm, good and soft; effective from 8-9f; consistent.

Name: Mathan
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when 2 1/4l third in a 9f handicap at Galway on most recent run; trained by a top course trainer; effective from 7-9f, enjoys cut and consistent.

Name: Refreshment
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when second, beaten 1/4l in a 9f handicap at Galway latest; effective from 8-9f on good and soft; consistent.

Name: Sunriseontheboyne
Timeform_comments: Outpaced, short of room and rallied when clear, finishing below form and appearing unsuited by the shorter trip when beaten 8 1/4l in a 9f handicap at Galway last time; tongue-tie first time; may prefer 9-10f; needs more in this grade.

Name: Dahlia Noir
Timeform_comments: Poorly placed to challenge in a race dominated from the front when beaten 7 1/4l in a handicap here last time; effective from 8-10f, acts on any going but enjoys cut; generally consistent.

Name: Howyoulikethat
Timeform_comments: Had too much to do in a race dominated from the front, beaten 5 1/4l in a 9f handicap at Galway last time. Generally out of form but has been running back into form after a long layoff. Effective at 1m and goes well at Killarney.

Name: Duckadilly
Timeform_comments: Below form when stepped up in grade on quicker ground, finishing fourth and beaten 6l in the Brownstown Stakes (Group 3) over 7f at Leopardstown last time. Effective at 7-8f.

Name: Evening Blossom
Timeform_comments: Ran below form when beaten 8l in a 9f handicap at Galway last time. Usually consistent and from a top course trainer. Acts on good and soft ground; progressive but now facing a tougher mark.

Name: Soft Winds
Timeform_comments: Made too much use of and finished 8l behind in the Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed) over 9f at Gowran Park last time. From a top course trainer, may need some cut, but looks vulnerable at Group/Listed level.

Name: Thalara
Timeform_comments: Improved when dropped back in trip, finishing 3 1/4l third in the Kooyonga Stakes (Listed) at Navan last time. Steadily progressive and returning from a short break, effective at 8-10f and capable at Listed level.

Name: Barbizon
Timeform_comments: Keen but improved for his debut experience to win the Conditions Race here by 2 1/4l last time. With a top course jockey booked, effective at 1m and has more to come.

Name: Ben Lawers
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when 3l third in a 9f maiden at Leopardstown last time. Steadily progressive and consistent over 8-9f on good ground, but needs to settle better.

Name: Expanded
Timeform_comments: From a yard that has won 3 of the last 5 runnings of this race. Disappointing when down the field in the Irish 2,000 Guineas (Group 1) at The Curragh last time. Returning from a short break and yet to show the ability displayed as a 2yo.

Name: Mississippi River
Timeform_comments: From a yard that has won 3 of the last 5 renewals. Below form when beaten 4 1/2l in a 9f handicap at Galway last time. Usually consistent, effective over 8-9f and acts on any ground, though can be frustrating.

Name: Fiery Lucy
Timeform_comments: Forced wide from a poor draw when down the field in the Corrib Fillies Stakes (Listed) over 7f at Galway last time. With a top jockey back on board, she acts on firm, good and soft, generally consistent at around 1m, and can bounce back.

Name: Queen Of The Bogs
Timeform_comments: Quickened clear comfortably and improved for her debut experience when winning a 9f maiden at The Curragh by 5l last time. Effective at 9-10f and worth a step up in grade.

Name: Shelbourne
Timeform_comments: Forced wide from a poor draw when beaten 8l in a handicap over 7f at Naas last time; effective at 7-8f.

Name: Star Mind
Timeform_comments: Did it cosily, back in form when landing a handicap by 1/2l off 62 over 7f at Naas last time in a strongly run race; effective at 7-8f; remains well treated on old UK form.

Name: Chavajod
Timeform_comments: Returned to form under positive handling when beaten 1/2l off 68 over 9f at Galway last time; best at 1m; inconsistent veteran.

Name: Darkdeserthighway
Timeform_comments: Below form when beaten 10l in a handicap at The Curragh last time; generally consistent at 1m on good ground; holds no secrets from the handicapper.

Name: Secret Magician
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when beaten 2l off 67 over 7f at Naas last time; effective at 6-7f, unproven over further.

Name: Speckled Meadow
Timeform_comments: Ran to current form when beaten 3 1/4l off 68 over 9f at Galway last time; effective at 7-8f, best with cut; handicapper finally relenting.

Timeform_comments: Quickened clear early and scored by 3l off 57 here penultimate start; effective 7-9f; can do better under a slightly more patient ride at 1m.

Timeform_comments: Outclassed up in grade when beaten 6 1/2l in a Rated Race over 7f at Limerick last time; effective at 7f; out of form in 2025.

Timeform_comments: Below form when beaten 4l off 65 over 7f at Naas last time; top jockey back on board; effective at 1m but yet to prove as effective on turf.

Name: No Such Thing
Timeform_comments: Too keen lit up by first-time visor when 13l third in a maiden here most recently; acts on good and soft; inconsistent.

Name: Senti Qua
Timeform_comments: Hampered early and had too much to do, improved in first-time cheekpieces when beaten 1/2l off 65 over 7f at Dundalk last time; top course jockey; consistent at 7-8f.

Name: Zaraahmando
Timeform_comments: Scored by 2l off 61 over 7f at Fairyhouse penultimate start; below form off a revised mark when beaten 15l off 69 last time; effective at 7f; stiff mark.

Name: Vegas Muse
Timeform_comments: Did plenty early lit up by blinkers when beaten 9l in a handicap at Galway last time; in good form prior; effective at 7-8f; generally consistent but frustrating.

Name: Brandon Creek
Timeform_comments: Blew the start and met trouble when down the field in a handicap over 12f at Galway last time; generally out of form but trainer in form; effective 8-12f on good or soft; bit more to come.

Name: Touted Plan
Timeform_comments: Improved with strong pace and stiff track when beaten a nose off 61 over 7f at Naas last time; best on sound surface; effective 7-8f; bit more to come.

Name: Daonethatgotaway
Timeform_comments: Scored by 3/4l off 65 at Bellewstown three starts back; outpaced and poorly placed when tenth beaten 8l off 72 last time; effective 8-10f; generally consistent.

Name: Nakasero
Timeform_comments: Made too much use of up in grade when down the field in a handicap over 7f at Naas most recently; usually consistent; effective on good to firm, good, or soft ground; generally consistent at around 1m, can bounce back down in grade.

Name: Alto Sax
Timeform_comments: Below form when well beaten in a handicap over 10f at Ballinrobe latest; cheekpieces first time; effective 7-10f on good ground, may not handle easier going; slow starts an issue.

Name: Comic Book

Name: Mo Ghille Mar

Name: Mon Coeur
Timeform_comments: Met trouble early but ran to his best when second, beaten 5l, in a handicap over 2m1f at Galway last time. Top jockey returns. Effective 12-16f, best with cut in the ground, and goes well at Galway.

Name: Brosna Town
Timeform_comments: Promising hurdle debut but comfortably held in a maiden hurdle over 2m1f at Galway last time. Trainer in form. Effective 12-14f on good ground and all-weather on the flat, but looks on a stiff enough mark.

Name: Granite Bay
Timeform_comments: Made too much use of the running and set it up for a closer when comfortably held in a Rated Race at Fairyhouse last time. In good form before that; effective 12-14f and probably best with some give in the ground; could progress again.

Name: Ragmans Corner
Timeform_comments: Improved up in trip for a cosy win, scoring by 2l off 73 at Navan in June. Hampered mid race but aided by leaders racing early, ran to form when second, beaten 1 1/2l off 115 last time. Top course jockey booked and looks well treated on flat form.

Name: Kilmeaden
Timeform_comments: Back to form when showing a willing attitude to land a handicap by a neck off 82 over 12f at Galway last time. Effective at 12f on good and soft ground. Still mileage in his mark on maiden form and may have more to offer over staying trips.

Name: Autumn Twist
Timeform_comments: Ran to form but challenged too early off a strong pace when beaten 8l in a handicap hurdle over 2m1f at Galway last time. Had been in good form beforehand and is progressive in both codes.

Name: Pinot Gris
Timeform_comments: Poorly placed and never threatened on flat return, needing the run when beaten 9 1/4l in a 2m handicap at The Curragh last time. Wears a visor for the first time. Off a short break. Effective 12-16f on good and soft ground, with scope on jumps form.

Name: Bibe Mus
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when appreciating the step up in trip on stable debut, beaten 4 1/4l in a 12f handicap at Galway last time. Effective 10-12f and likely to show more for the new yard over staying trips.

Name: Chutzpal
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when beaten 4l off 70 at Wolverhampton last time. Effective 12-14f on good ground and all-weather.

Name: Empress Alma
Timeform_comments: Unsuited by how the race developed on a quick return but not disgraced when beaten 10l in a Galway handicap last time. Usually consistent, held up, and effective from middle to staying distances on good or soft ground.

Name: Gangster Granny
Timeform_comments: Below form and finished down the field in a 12f Galway handicap most recently. Generally out of form and wears blinkers for the first time. Effective at 12-14f on good or soft ground but form is regressing and needs an easier task.

Name: Miss Gitana
Timeform_comments: Well backed when winning by 1/2l off 65 over 2m at Tramore in July. Stopped quickly and ran to form when eighth, beaten 14l off 97 last time.

Name: Atheneum
Timeform_comments: Below form when dropped in trip and finished down the field in a 12f Galway handicap most recently. Cheekpieces on first time. Effective 12-14f on good or soft ground. Still early days and could bounce back.

Name: Beautiful Chaos
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when stepped up in trip, beaten 4l off 65 at Galway last time. Effective at 12-14f. A veteran on a long losing run but in good heart.

Name: Ehteyat

Name: Makaiah

Name: Lady Kai
Timeform_comments: Unseated rider in a 1m7f Leopardstown handicap latest. Consistent at 12-14f on a sound surface. Big chance up in trip.

Name: Bear Creek

Name: Eagles Dream
Timeform_comments: Below form on softer ground when finishing down the field in a 12f Galway handicap last time. Had been in good form prior. Effective at 10-12f on good or yielding ground. Consistent but current mark looks about right.

Name: Ellaat
Timeform_comments: Had too much to do after meeting trouble at a key stage when beaten 9l in a Galway handicap last time. Effective at 12-14f on the flat, with best efforts when the ground has cut.

Name: Wertpol
Timeform_comments: Outpaced and below form on handicap debut, beaten 6l over 8f at Leopardstown last time. Usually consistent, with trainer in form. Returns from a short break and looks in need of a step up from 8-10f. Has been well backed last twice and mark looks fair.

Name: Decorated Elle
Timeform_comments: Outpaced, needed the run, and appeared unsuited by the drop in trip when finishing down the field in an 8f Curragh handicap most recently. Usually consistent but needs a return to longer distances. Should come on for reappearance but has a bit to prove.

Name: Youllfindandsee
Timeform_comments: Pulled up in a maiden hurdle over 2m4f at Cork last time. Needs to prove ability remains after a long layoff.

Name: Gentleman Joe
Timeform_comments: Improved again when appreciating the fast ground, winning the Conditions Race (Amateurs) at Leopardstown over 1m7f by 1/2l last time. Acts on any surface but seems to prefer faster ground, and is a progressive stayer on the flat.

Name: Enniskerry
Timeform_comments: Ran to form when well beaten in the Galway Hurdle (G3) over 2m at Galway last time. Had been in good form prior but has a bit to find here.

Name: Run For Oscar
Timeform_comments: Ran to form in the contest he won in 2022, finishing fourth and beaten 1 1/4l in a 2m2f handicap at Newmarket last time. Returning from a long layoff; a veteran thorough stayer who was in good form when last seen. This is a probable prep for the Cesarewitch.

Name: Appian Way
Timeform_comments: Disappointing on flat return when finishing down the field in a 2m maiden at Tramore most recently. Out of form in both codes.

Name: He Who Dares
Timeform_comments: Made a modest debut when well beaten in a 2m maiden at Tramore last time. Trainer is in form, but poor over hurdles and will need more time on the flat.

Name: Mont St Michel
Timeform_comments: Probably made his move too soon when a 5l third in a 12f maiden at Galway on his most recent run. Effective from 12f to 14f, he has shown a good level of form and should be winning soon.

Name: Simpletwistoffaith
Timeform_comments: Poor flat debut when down the field in a 12f maiden at Galway most recently. Generally out of form and regressive over jumps prior to that start; can only be watched at present.

Name: Sorrentino
Timeform_comments: Yard has won 3 of the last 8 runnings of this race. Very promising debut when second, beaten 1/2l, in the Conditions Race (Amateurs) over 1m5f at Listowel most recently. Off a short break, he is a bumper winner with more to come and should do better over 2m.

Name: Tullyhogue Fort
Timeform_comments: Unseated in a 2m6f handicap chase at Roscommon last time. Consistent but has a poor strike rate.
